topic: Group campaign metrics and POI data
summary_markdown:
The discussion focused on two key analytics tasks. First, the need to develop metrics for group campaigns, specifically addressing issues related to varying campaign durations and different buckets. Previously, a requirement was noted where Japanese stakeholders wanted different slot durations within a single campaign across various frames; however, this was adjusted to segment them into smaller, manageable campaigns that could then be grouped. The core task of developing these metrics remains.

Second, the integration of Point-of-Interest (POI) data into mops-ai was discussed. [me] suggested that the previous failure to integrate POI might be due to limitations in the AI model at the time, noting that current models are significantly more advanced and should facilitate successful implementation.
decisions: The development of group campaign metrics is a priority task.
action_items: [p1] will take ownership of developing POI integration into mops-ai if the metric work proves too complex for [me].
[me] will share any progress made on the group campaign metrics with [p1].
